node.statement: Let M be a smooth manifold without boundary. Smooth means C-infinity, so its transition maps are C^1; hence M is a C^1 manifold. The shard records that Munkres uses non-bounded for a manifold without boundary. Therefore M satisfies the non-bounded C^1 hypothesis of GT-munkres-edt-thm-10.6.
